name: Cypark Resources Berhad
overview: 今年公司业务层面的公告主要是与 RGFC Ventures 的 MOBE 延长至 2027 年 7 月 31 日，以及与 Masdar 的 MOU 仍无实质进展；其余公告多为附加股、凭单、融资及公司秘书/董事委员会变动等企业活动。最新一季（2026-07-31）营收 1.80048 亿令吉，同比增 332.2%，净利润 569.6 万令吉。
overview_en: The main business-related announcements this year were the extension of the MOBE with RGFC Ventures to 31 July 2027 and no material development on the MOU with Masdar; the remaining announcements were mostly corporate activities such as rights issues, warrants, fund raising and changes in company secretary/board committees. Latest quarter (31 July 2026) revenue was MYR 180.048 million, up 332.2% year-on-year, with net profit of MYR 5.696 million.

segments.name: 可再生能源
segments.note: 与 RGFC Ventures 的业务探索备忘录延长至 2027 年 7 月 31 日，与 Masdar 的 MOU 无实质进展。
segments.note_en: The business exploration memorandum with RGFC Ventures was extended to 31 July 2027, while the MOU with Masdar saw no material development.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 RGFC Ventures Sdn. Bhd. 于 2023 年 8 月 1 日签订的业务探索备忘录（MOBE）延长至 2027 年 7 月 31 日。
actions.text_en: The Memorandum of Business Exploration (MOBE) dated 1 August 2023 with RGFC Ventures Sdn. Bhd. was extended until 31 July 2027.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company PJSC - Masdar 于 2023 年 12 月 1 日签订的 MOU 自上次公告以来无实质进展。
actions.text_en: There has been no material development on the MOU dated 1 December 2023 with Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company PJSC - Masdar since the previous announcement.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 RGFC Ventures 的 MOBE 及与 Masdar 的 MOU 自 2026 年 3 月 19 日公告以来均无实质进展。
actions.text_en: Both the MOBE with RGFC Ventures and the MOU with Masdar saw no material development since the announcement dated 19 March 2026.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 RGFC Ventures 的 MOBE 及与 Masdar 的 MOU 自 2025 年 12 月 16 日公告以来均无实质进展。
actions.text_en: Both the MOBE with RGFC Ventures and the MOU with Masdar saw no material development since the announcement dated 16 December 2025.
